rule: Lowercase letters act on the focused item and never navigate. Capitals spend or destroy. Digits switch rooms. Symbols (: / ? .) open tools. There is no undo. Confirm only discard, drop, stopping a run and dismissing a setup issue. The footer, the ? overlay and the palette all read this registry.
scope: A key bound to a view wins over a global (`*`) binding in that view: on Plan `c` is confirm, not copy id; in the test overlay `y` is pass.
confirm: only discard (D), drop (X), stopping a run and dismissing a setup issue ask to confirm

fields.key: the key as the footer prints it
fields.label: the footer / overlay word for it
fields.when: the condition on the focused item or state
fields.priority: footer drop order when the width is short: 1 is kept longest (the 80-column Desk footer keeps y, n, ⏎ and ? and drops ↑↓ and :)
fields.side: left = verbs for the focused item, right = global keys
fields.layer: ux-spec keymap layer: L0 everyone, L1 verbs, L2 vim motions, L3 everything else
fields.id: every entry, global ones included, has an id

global.label: open
global.when: drill in; the footer names what it opens (open story, watch run, story, read, open)

global.label: back
global.when: climb back a level or close an overlay

global.label: next pane
global.when: moves focus to the next pane or field

global.label: quit
global.when: press q twice within 2 s; the daemon keeps working, and the first quit of a session says so once

global.label: top / bottom
global.when: G also follows the run stream

global.label: next / previous match
global.when: only while a search (/ filter) is open; otherwise n is no

global.label: retry
global.when: an action failed; resends with the same request id

global.label: copy id
global.when: copies the focused story or run id; not in Plan, where c is confirm

actions.label: approve
actions.when: item.kind == MERGE

actions.label: reject
actions.when: item.kind == MERGE

actions.label: test

actions.label: PR
actions.when: item.kind == MERGE

actions.label: accept
actions.when: item.kind == PROPOSED STORY
actions.consequence: DeskAction.consequence (engine addition): Accepting files it as a Backlog draft. You refine it in a triage session.

actions.label: dismiss
actions.when: item.kind == PROPOSED STORY

actions.label: dismiss
actions.when: item.kind == DECISION NOTE

actions.label: idea…
actions.when: always: hands the maintainer's quick idea to the audit (0022)

actions.label: Start it
actions.when: item.kind == NEXT UP

actions.label: Offer the next one
actions.when: item.kind == NEXT UP

actions.label: answer
actions.when: item.kind == QUESTION, or PARKED ambiguous-spec (same as r)

actions.label: start again
actions.when: item.kind == PARKED and reason != scope-violation; also a failed run (same action as retry)

actions.label: overrule and approve

actions.label: inspect

actions.label: start again

actions.label: start again with a hint

actions.label: open run
actions.when: run failed, or PARKED verify-failing · conflict · worker-failed · by-maintainer

actions.label: steer
actions.when: a running developer session; a reviewer session answers 'Not steerable: the reviewer is working'

actions.label: watch run

actions.label: full graph

actions.label: discard

actions.label: done

actions.label: go there

offline: While offline only ↑↓ move, ⏎ read and q q quit show, then 'actions off while offline' in err. Action keys disappear from the footer instead of failing when pressed.
noKey: An action without a key shows its exact cli line (dim, starting with $) in the preview and in the ? overlay under 'NO KEY · TYPE IT'.
